name: Firebase Cloud Messaging
description: Send native Android push notifications through the Firebase Cloud Messaging HTTP v1 API using a Firebase service account.

credential_fields.name: service_account_json
credential_fields.label: Firebase service account JSON
credential_fields.description: Paste the complete service-account JSON downloaded from Firebase Console > Project settings > Service accounts.

credential_fields.name: relay_encryption_key
credential_fields.label: Relay encryption key
credential_fields.description: Generated automatically by Apteva when the connection is created. Push uses it to encrypt FCM registration tokens at rest.

tools.name: send_message
tools.description: Send one Firebase Cloud Messaging HTTP v1 message to a registration token, topic, or condition.

message.description: Complete FCM Message object containing exactly one target and any notification, data, Android, APNs, or Webpush options.

validate_only.description: Validate the request without delivering the message.
